title: UN Commission of Inquiry publishes report on the Occupied Palestinian Territory and Israel (A/81/460)
detail: The UN Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel published its report A/81/460 as an advance unedited version, per a feed item on October 30, 2026. The feed summary gives only the title and document number; findings are not summarized here and should be checked against the report itself.

title: Palestinian-American beaten nearly to death by Israeli settlers in occupied West Bank
detail: A news report published October 30, 2026 says a Palestinian-American man was beaten nearly to death by Israeli settlers in the occupied West Bank. The feed summary gives only the headline; location, date of the attack and the victim's identity were not provided and should be checked against the full article.
